name: Poem Mountain
summary: A 106 m hill over Cửa Lục: take in the flag, the roofs, and the bay on a shore stop in Hồng Gai. Long Tiên Pagoda and Đức Ông Temple sit at the foot, on the national ranking of 31 August 1992. A flag was raised here on the morning of 1 May 1930. Come in daylight so the flag and the summit read together.
getThere: On the Hong Gai shore, across Bai Chay Bridge from Bai Chay
heroCaption: The hill, the flag, the roofs, and the bay
gettingThere: The hill is in phường Hồng Gai. From Bãi Cháy you cross Cầu Bãi Cháy.

legs.heading: From Bai Chay
legs.body: Across Cầu Bãi Cháy to the Hồng Gai shore, then up to the hill.

closed: No weekly closing day was printed.
admissionNote: The hill was ranked a national relic by Quyết định 1140-QĐ/BT on 31 August 1992. Chùa Long Tiên, built in 1941 under the Nguyễn court with a three-door gate, shares that ranking. Đền Đức Ông shares it too. The temple courtyard is 2,531.8 m² in a 2011 decision and 2,689.8 m² in a 2013 adjustment.
